incidents.detail: Ariana Grande's Eternal Sunshine Tour North American leg makes its Austin stop with three nights: June 24, June 26, and June 27 at Moody Center ATX. Tonight is Night 1. Venue capacity ~15,000; show start time 8:10 PM. Tour opened June 6 in Oakland. Austin is the only multi-night Texas stop. Expected crowd demographics: primarily young adult female fans; well-organized major touring production. incidents.title: US-IRAN TALKS INCREASINGLY FRAGILE — TRUMP THREATENS WALKOUT
incidents.relevance: Low direct threat to Austin operations. Heightened geopolitical instability may affect high-value guest mix — corporate executives, government-adjacent travelers. Monitor federal building perimeter (US Courthouse, Capitol complex 0.5 mi NW) for any protest activity. Oil markets sensitive — if talks collapse, energy price spikes could affect hotel operations costs.
incidents.detail: June 24 developments: Trump threatened to abandon Iran negotiations if Iran and Oman impose Strait of Hormuz transit tolls. IAEA Director-General Grossi confirmed nuclear site inspections will occur under the interim deal but stated exact timing is 'not essential.' Pakistani FM Andrabi stated technical working group talks will restart 'next week' (week of Jun 30), with Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday as possible start dates. Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf described the Islamabad MOU as 'a declaration of America's defeat.' US Treasury 60-day sanctions waiver runs through August 21. Fragility is increasing: both sides publicly contradicting each other on inspection scope, toll rights, and timing.

incidents.title: SUSTAINED HEAT EVENT — THURSDAY ESCALATION WATCH
incidents.relevance: Maintain all heat protocols for Day 3: hydration stations at door and valet, shade-break schedules for outdoor staff. Tonight's concert arrivals (5–8 PM) coincide with peak heat window — monitor outdoor queue management. Engineering to confirm HVAC fully operational at all zones before peak heat hours.
incidents.detail: Day 3 of sustained heat event. High 93–97°F today; heat index 97–105°F during peak hours. NWS watching for Thursday and Friday escalation — prior forecasts indicated 105–110°F+ heat index Thursday, potentially reaching Heat Advisory threshold. CBS Austin confirms no advisory in effect today but tracking tomorrow closely. Austin cooling centers open at library branches and Parks & Recreation facilities.
